edit: NINJA SPRINT KEY POSE. Same bandit identity, costume, scale, and each original facing direction. Full body in an athletic RUNNING stride, torso leaning forward along travel. BOTH arms fully extended BACKWARDS at the SHOULDERS, elbows nearly straight. Both upper arms and forearms point opposite travel in one continuous line. Two separate relaxed hands trail past the hips on their own sides, visibly clear of the belt/back. Hands never touch each other or the body. Arms trail behind like the scarf tails, never sideways like airplane wings and never forward in front of chest. Strong readable forward lean and rearward straight-arm silhouette. Preserve plain cloth headband/no logos, mask, ponytail, red scarf, charcoal outfit, wraps, pouches, sandals; transparent background, no floor shadow. Keep whole figure inside native128px canvas.
